typeHint.VALUE_CHAIN: Process landscape: primary activities as chevrons, management and support as blocks. Elements drill down to processes or other diagrams.
typeHint.ORG_CHART: Organisational units, positions and persons with reporting lines and staff functions.
typeHint.DMN: Decision tables with hit policies, typed inputs and outputs, linked to business rule tasks.
typeHint.EPC: Events, functions and connectors (ARIS notation), convertible to BPMN.
typeHint.SIPOC: Suppliers, inputs, process steps, outputs and customers of one process.

deleteText: The diagram is removed from the repository and the portal. Its history stays in the audit log.

fields.processHint: The diagram is shown under this process in the repository tree.

whereUsed.none: No other diagram refers to this one.

links.all: All links of the diagram. Select an element to add links.

importFailed: The diagram could not be loaded
invalidContent: The diagram content is not valid
selectElement: Select an element to see and edit its properties.

dmn.translationsHint: Names in {{language}}: the editor shows the active language.
dmn.noTable: The model has no decision table yet.
dmn.testHint: Enter input values and run: the matching rules are highlighted in the table. FEEL unary tests are evaluated with feelin.

errors.UNIQUE_VIOLATION: Hit policy UNIQUE: more than one rule matches.
errors.ANY_CONFLICT: Hit policy ANY: the matching rules give different outputs.
errors.EVALUATION: The decision could not be evaluated.

issues.NO_TABLE_RULES: The decision table has no rules.
issues.EMPTY_OUTPUT: A rule has an empty output.
issues.DUPLICATE_RULE: Two rules have the same input entries.

dmn.linkHint: The business rule decided by this step.

portal.title: Diagrams
portal.subtitle: Value chains, organisation charts, decision tables, EPCs and SIPOCs — approved versions.
portal.drillHint: Click a highlighted element to open the process or diagram behind it.

valueChain.generateHint: Build the value chain from the Management / Core / Support processes of the process house
valueChain.generateReplace: The diagram is replaced by frames for Management, Core and Support with their level-1 processes, each linked to its process. You can undo by restoring a version.
valueChain.generateFromHouse: Generate the first version from the process house (level-1 processes)
valueChain.linkedHint: Clicking the element drills down to it (in the portal: when it is published).

org.unitHint: The department this unit stands for (generated charts keep it in sync).
org.userHint: Optional: the employee holding the position.
org.roleHint: The position is the Role used in lanes and steps of the process models.
org.performsNone: The role performs no step yet.
org.regenerateHint: Update the chart from departments, roles and people; manual edits are kept
org.mergeHint: Generated units, positions and people are matched by id: they keep their position and colours and take the current names; new ones are added, those whose source no longer exists are removed. Elements and lines you added yourself stay.
org.roleDepartmentHint: Department of the position in organisation charts.
